newGame.title: New game
newGame.mixedVariant: {scenario} (choose A or B for each villain)
newGame.modularsHint: The scenario's recommended set is chosen to begin with; add or swap others to vary it.
newGame.difficultyHint: Expert adds the expert encounter set and starts the villain a stage later.
newGame.noDecks: You have no decks yet. Load one from a MarvelCDB link, or import it on the Decks page.
newGame.allowSpectatorsHint: List this game on the Watch page so anyone can watch it. Spectators see the table but cannot take any actions.
newGame.campaignModeHint: The expert campaign keeps each hero's damage from one scenario to the next, and heals it with obligations.
newGame.scenarioDifficultyHint: Each scenario's difficulty: expert adds the expert set and starts the villain a stage later.
newGame.playersHint: In the lobby each seat takes a deck: take them all yourself, or send friends the link to take theirs.
newGame.campaignPlayersHint: In the lobby each seat takes a deck, its hero kept for the whole campaign: take them all yourself, or send friends the link to take theirs.

version.title: Version
version.hint: Standard puts each villain's version A into play, expert its version B. Extreme starts each version A with its version B under it, entering play when it is defeated. Or the players choose version A or B for each villain.
